verdict.rationale: Expensify's docs claim SmartScan reads merchant, date, total, and currency in real time from a photographed receipt (expensify-docs-6, expensify-docs-18), which covers the photo-capture and OCR-to-transaction-filing part of the story. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the 'automatic' framing: users report ~70% mis-categorization, reliance on mechanical-turk human workers (raising accuracy and privacy issues) rather than pure OCR, and slow processing that led one user to enter data manually instead (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-2, expensify-comm-4, expensify-comm-5). No evidence at all addresses the 'forward an email' capture path. Missing for 10: evidence of email-forwarded receipt capture, and independent verification that categorization/filing accuracy matches vendor claims.
